title: Deautonomising the Lyness mapping
summary: We examine the Lyness mapping (an integrable $N$th-order discrete system which can be generated from a one-dimensional reduction of the Hirota-Miwa equation) from the point of view of deautonomisation. We show that only the $N=2$ case can be deautonomised when one works with the standard form of the mapping. However it turns out that deautonomisation is possible for arbitrary $N$ when one considers the derivative form of the Lyness mapping.
